standards.name: IS 694:2010
standards.description: Bureau of Indian Standards - PVC insulated (heavy duty) electric cables/wires for working voltages up to and including 1100 V. Electrolytic-grade copper conductor; conductor cross-sections 0.5-630 sq mm; 660 V working / 1100 V test. Governing standard.

sqmm.canonical_term: Size - conductor nominal cross-sectional area in mm2 (Size)

Ampacity.canonical_term: Current Carrying Capacity - the current a conductor can carry continuously, in A (Current Carrying Capacity)

1100 V grade.canonical_term: Voltage Rating - 660 V working / 1100 V test grade per IS 694 (Voltage Rating)

industry_references.name: APAR house-wire current-rating (ampacity) chart (manufacturer)
industry_references.description: Manufacturer ampacity chart giving current ratings per conductor size for house wiring. Manufacturer reference, not a governing standard.

industry_references.name: Aesteiron current carrying capacity of copper conductors (supplier)
industry_references.description: Supplier reference chart of copper conductor current-carrying capacity by size. Reference, not a governing standard.
